applicability_boundaries: An upstream system semantic critic resolves the confirmed qualitative tone to a controlled family identity and binds that result to the exact tone hash.
Production selection does not parse natural-language tone with literal substrings or substitute a nearest composable trait combination.
Visual System catalog evidence supports only directly persisted palette and typography fields in these bundles.
Material, geometry, and motion claims in these bundles remain layout-template-level direct evidence.
Background overlay adaptation is normative and does not upgrade opaque source layouts into overlay evidence.
A uniquely resolved retained identity selects only that family; ambiguous, unsupported, or unresolved identities return explicit failures.

rules: Prototype IDs select macro structural envelopes, not fixed finished styles.
Concrete palette, typography, material, geometry, and motion tokens are system design decisions.
Exact source colors, fonts, markup, techniques, and compositions are not copied.
Unsupported direct trait dimensions remain coverage gaps and are not inferred.
No additional cluster is created to increase style count.
